Documented unbroken provenance.provides: confident attribution and title, a premium price

Gap in the ownership record.provides: suspicion of wartime looting, a discount and slow sale

Known forgery exposed.provides: no artistic value at all, a criminal question

Recently excavated antiquity.provides: near-certain illicit export, no lawful market

Scientific dating of materials.provides: an objective date range for the materials, no evidence about authorship

Archival ownership documents.requires: surviving papers and access to them
Archival ownership documents.provides: a chain of title, vulnerability to forged paperwork

Connoisseurship judgement.requires: an acknowledged expert in the artist
Connoisseurship judgement.provides: an attribution opinion, no objective test

No documentation whatsoever.provides: no chain of title available, reliance on the object alone

Heirs of a dispossessed owner.provides: a restitution claim, strong moral weight

Source country authority.provides: a state demand for return, diplomatic pressure

Defrauded purchaser.provides: a civil claim against the seller, no claim to the object itself

Sale proceeds at full value.provides: the object transferred, the price realised

Restitution to the claimant.provides: the object handed over, compensation sometimes paid

Object withdrawn from sale.provides: no transaction, the object returned to the consignor
